messages:
Maya CSM: Quick heads-up on AuroraHealth onboarding: activation metrics show p95 tail spiking during batch summarization jobs. Renewal is in two weeks and usage is growing. I'd like to propose a small, staged perf experiment: swap to a compact int8 variant for short summaries, add a routing rule by token length, and enable KV prefix caching for chat sessions. Thoughts?

Ravi Eng: Sounds reasonable. We have a compact-int8 variant available: redwood/summarizer-lite-int8. For batching workflows we should also tweak batch_size and max_batch_delay for the dedicated pool to avoid queuing spikes. I can prep a canary and config diff.

Priya ML: Agree. Main quality risk is compression-induced abstraction errors. Recommend a 150-example eval from their prod prompts (anonymized) and a hallucination heuristic check. Also test with conversation prefixes to confirm KV cache doesn't drop context tokens.

Theo Platform: Proposed rollout: staging smoke -> 2% canary for 90 minutes -> 10% for 4 hours -> monitor then ramp. Canary gates: p95 <= baseline + 15ms, error-rate delta <= 0.5% absolute, quality drop <= 2% relative on ROUGE-L proxy. I'll provision a tiny dedicated slice and freeze autoscale during the canary window.

Maya CSM: Great. Can we have a short customer-facing blurb for AuroraHealth saying it's a non-disruptive perf test and we'll revert if quality metrics degrade? I'd like to mention expected improvements.

Ravi Eng: Short blurb: "We're running a short performance trial to route short summaries to a compact, quantized model to reduce latency and cost with close quality monitoring and a clear rollback plan. Expected: ~25-35% p95 improvement for short summaries."

NotifyBot: Canary scheduled: AuroraHealth summarizer at 2026-06-14T16:00Z (2% traffic, 90m). Monitoring: perf-alerts, eval-harness.

Priya ML: I'll kick off the eval harness at canary start. We should also log sample outputs for manual review. If ROUGE drops >2% or hallucination heuristic increases by >1.5x, fail canary.

Theo Platform: Routing snippet:

```json
{ "routes": [ {"name": "short", "match": "input_tokens <= 120", "model": "redwood/summarizer-lite-int8", "weight": 1}, {"name": "long", "match": "input_tokens > 120", "model": "redwood/summarizer-std", "weight": 1} ], "canary": {"percent": 2, "duration_minutes": 90} }
```

Maya CSM: Thanks. Owners: Ravi (deploy/rollback), Priya (quality checks), Theo (canary infra), Maya (customer comms). Please drop the blurb here and ping me when canary is green so I can inform the customer before their morning sync.

Ravi Eng: Blurb posted above. Also adding CLI for rollback:

```bash
rwctl routes apply -f aurora-routing.json --canary 2
rwctl routes rollback aurora-routing --to previous
```

Theo Platform: Reserved 1 GPU slice, disabled burst autoscale. Dashboard link: https://redwood.console/dashboards/canary/aurora/ (will populate at canary start).

Maya CSM: Appreciated. Let's keep the communication tight since renewal is close.

-- thread end --
